title: Accounting Manual, Part Four: Reckoning the Year-End Grain Volume on a Membership and Patronage Equity Account
content:
The qualifying grain volume a member earns for a fiscal year that has already closed is worked out for Membership and Patronage Equity from the settlement statements on their grain business rather than from what they remember hauling.

## The quantities

**The volume settled inside the fiscal year.** This is the net settled bushels standing on the member's grain settlement statements recorded in the 17 months up to today, less the net settled bushels standing on the statements recorded in the 5 months up to today, so that what is left is the volume the cooperative settled with them inside the year that closed.

**Where the close of the year is drawn.** The 5-month mark is where the desk draws the close of the year, and a record dated between that mark and the last day of the fiscal year falls to the new year by it, the mark and not the calendar deciding the side a record lies on.

**The volume that counts.** The volume settled inside the year counts in full and carries no conditioning allowance, and the volume so taken is rounded to two decimal places.

**The volume already standing accrued.** This is read from the allocation notice posted for that year on the grain basis.

**The volume still to be credited.** This is the volume that counts less the volume already standing accrued, rounded to two decimal places, and where that difference would be less than nothing, nothing further is credited.

**Rounding.** Every figure this rule works out is carried to two decimal places, and a half cent rounds up.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

| Quantity | Hypothetical figure |
| --- | --- |
| net settled bushels on statements recorded in the 17 months up to today | 41600.00 |
| net settled bushels on statements recorded in the 5 months up to today | 9350.00 |
| volume settled inside the fiscal year | 32250.00 |
| volume that counts, rounded to two decimal places | 32250.00 |
| volume already standing accrued on the year's grain allocation notice | 28100.00 |
| volume still to be credited | 4150.00 |

Taking the whole of the 17 months and then taking away the 5 months leaves 32250.00 bushels as the volume settled inside the year that closed. That volume counts as it stands. Set against the 28100.00 already standing accrued, 4150.00 remains to be credited.

## A second illustration, where nothing further is due

On the same reckoning, a member whose volume that counts is 19000.00 and whose year already stands accrued at 21500.00 reaches a difference of less than nothing. Nothing further is credited to that fiscal year.
